Package org.apache.beam.sdk.io.iceberg

Class SideInputTable

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.io.iceberg.SideInputTable
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.iceberg.Table
@Internal public class SideInputTable extends Object implements org.apache.iceberg.Table
A lightweight adapter that implements Table backed by a SerializableTableSpec.

Delegates declarative metadata (schemas, partition specs, sort orders, properties) and FileIO to the broadcasted SerializableTableSpec, and reconstructs the EncryptionManager from catalog properties or falls back to PlaintextEncryptionManager.

All non-metadata or mutating operations (e.g. refresh(), currentSnapshot(), newAppend(), updateSchema()) throw UnsupportedOperationException. Table commits are handled centrally in AppendFilesToTables.
